source:
@@U02675@@
Or, if you like, ascend!
It’s all the same.
Leave behind the created world and
enter the unbound world of pure forms,
and find pleasure in what has long ceased to be.
They will swirl about you like drifting clouds;
but you have only to brandish the key
to keep them away.

@@U02677@@
(Enthusiastically.)

@@U02678@@
Right!
Grasping it firmly now
I feel new strength!
My chest expands!
On to the Great Work!

@@U02680@@
When you see a glowing tripod,
you'll know you have reached the deepest of all depths.
By its gleam you will see the Mothers.
Some will be seated, others standing or strolling—
as chance will have it.
Formation, transformation:
Eternal Mind’s eternal conservation.
They're swarmed around by all of creation’s creatures,
but all they see are empty forms:
you wont be seen.
Be bold, the danger is great.
Walk straight to the tripod and touch it with the key.
(浮士德, with the key, assumes a decidedly commanding attitude as
梅菲斯特 watches him.)
That’s the way!
Like an honorable servant
it will connect and follow you.
Good fortune will raise you up,
and before they notice, you'll be back here with it.
translation:
@@U02675@@
或者，如果你愿意，可以上升！
都是一样的。
留下创造的世界，
进入纯粹形式的无拘无束的世界，
并在早已不复存在的事物中找到乐趣。
它们会像流云一样围绕着你；
但你只需挥舞钥匙
让他们远离。

@@U02677@@
（热情地。）

@@U02678@@
对了！
现在牢牢抓住它
我感受到了新的力量！
我的胸膛扩大了！
继续伟大的工作！

@@U02680@@
当你看到发光的三脚架时，
你会知道你已经到达了最深处。
通过它的光芒，你会看到母亲们。
有些人会坐着，有些人会站着或散步——
机会来了。
形成、转变：
永恒心灵的永恒保守。
它们被所有造物的生物包围，
但他们看到的只是空洞的形式：
你不会被看见。
大胆一点，危险很大。
径直走到三脚架前，用钥匙触碰它。
（浮士德拿着钥匙，摆出一副决然的指挥姿态
梅菲斯特看着他。）
就是这样！
就像一位尊贵的仆人
它会连接并跟随您。
好运会让你高升，
在他们注意到之前，你就会带着它回到这里。
